title: 第267章 新天修士们的新任务第266章 大自在
content_zh:
第267章新天修士们的新任务
杨元真的入道境界最终稳稳定格在了聚气三重，道基牢固、修为扎实，都不需要陈阳再出手进行压境。
这样的入道成绩，对比其他拥有顶尖资质的沧澜天骄，只能算是上等，还达不到顶尖的水平。
不过在陈阳看来，以杨元真本身的特殊情况，能以三重境界稳稳入道，没有遇到什么太多的波折，就已经算是一份相当不错的结果了。
依照此前的安排，杨灵睿随后便进入了陈阳的本体洞天之内，与霜华神尊一道研究海阁真君所得的那份生杀之法。
杨元真也跟随陈阳入驻了神临峰，正式开启了自己的漫漫修行之路。
与此同时的另一边，苍龙族邪法之乱的善后事宜也在有条不紊的开展。
在夜沉锋和杨元鸿等新天修士的助力之下，那些潜藏在苍龙族地深处的邪法被逐一的揪了出来，并在杨灵睿的杀道判令之下烟消云散。
原本苍龙族的高层修士们，在了解了邪法的由来的和危害后，都已经做好了两位族中天骄双双殒命的准备。
结果后来得知苍屿还保住了一条性命和大半修道根基，他们便是大喜过望，对着陈怀安等人就是好一阵的千恩万谢。
苍屿随后接受了杨元鸿等人的治疗，并于半日之后成功苏醒。
这时再回想此前修炼邪法之事，这位苍龙族天骄还是感到十分后怕，他不敢想象若是自己继续将这道邪法修炼下去，最终会给苍龙族招来何等严重的灾祸。
同时，对于救下自己一条性命的陈怀安，苍屿也是万分感谢，并当着两方修士的面，以苍龙族脉起誓，待自己修成真意境界之后，便会离开苍龙族地，认陈怀安为主，听从这位水泽灵君的一切调遣。
当然了，关于陈怀安那具法躯的记忆，陈阳已经借分身石体之力，悄悄对苍屿的记忆进行了修改替换。
合道神通术目前可是自己这一方压箱底的杀手锏，在条件允许的情况下，自然是知道的人越少越好。
一月之后，夜沉锋和杨元鸿确认苍龙族地内的邪法遗存都已经被清除干净，便又立马投入到了新任务的准备之中。
通过这次两方的商议，苍龙族也是在道院的许可下，得到了重新入世沧澜的机会。
不过这份机会并不是对所有苍龙族修士都开放，是有条件且分阶段的。
此事之后，杨元鸿和神武会继续在苍龙族地内驻留一段时间。
前者会进入苍龙族脉的幻境之中进行修道感悟，并以自身真龙之息以及龙君气象反哺这一方灵族的族脉。

这对两方来说是一件互利共惠的双赢之事，苍龙族的四名老祖自然是非常乐意。
只不过他们不知道的是，杨元鸿除了要在苍龙族幻境之中为自身的龙体修炼需求突破契机，还会借着这次进入苍龙族脉的机会，为自己的儿子寻觅一份入道机缘。
杨玄苍乃是先天苍龙异体，并且还很好的继承了杨元鸿的肉身天赋，但正如此前所言，这孩子的资质距离顶尖天骄还差了一线。
这份先天禀赋的差距，是陈阳通过后天的悟道馈赠很难弥补的，所以为了能够让自己的儿子有一个更高的入道起点，杨元鸿和东方盈彩这些年来，也一直在想方设法给杨玄苍寻觅各类进补之物。
content_en:
Chapter 267 The new mission of the Xintian monks
Yang Yuanzhen's Taoist realm was finally stabilized at the third level of Qi Gathering. With a solid Taoist foundation and solid cultivation, there was no need for Chen Yang to suppress the realm again.
Compared with other Canglan Tianjiao with top qualifications, such entry results can only be regarded as superior, not yet reaching the top level.
However, in Chen Yang's view, considering Yang Yuanzhen's special situation, being able to enter the Tao at the third level steadily without encountering too many twists and turns is already a pretty good result.
According to the previous arrangement, Yang Lingrui then entered the cave of Chen Yang's body and studied the life and death methods learned by True Monarch Haige together with Lord Shuanghua.
Yang Yuanzhen also followed Chen Yang and settled in Shenlin Peak, officially starting his long journey of cultivation.
At the same time, on the other side, the aftermath of the Canglong clan’s evil law chaos is also proceeding in an orderly manner.
With the help of Xintian monks such as Ye Chenfeng and Yang Yuanhong, the evil spells hidden deep in the Canglong tribe were uncovered one by one, and disappeared under Yang Lingrui's killing order.
Originally, the senior monks of the Canglong Clan, after understanding the origin and harm of the evil spell, had already made preparations for the death of the two geniuses in the clan.
As a result, they later learned that Cangyu had saved one life and most of his cultivation foundation. They were overjoyed and expressed their gratitude to Chen Huaian and others for a while.
Cangyu subsequently received treatment from Yang Yuanhong and others, and successfully woke up half a day later.
At this time, thinking back to the practice of the evil method before, this genius of the Canglong Clan still felt very scared. He could not imagine what serious disaster it would eventually bring to the Canglong Clan if he continued to practice this evil method.
At the same time, Cangyu was extremely grateful to Chen Huaian for saving his life. In front of the two monks, he swore on the Canglong clan that after he attained the realm of true meaning, he would leave the Canglong clan, recognize Chen Huaian as his master, and obey all the orders of the Shuizhe Lingjun.
Of course, regarding the memory of Chen Huaian's magical body, Chen Yang had quietly modified and replaced Cangyu's memory with the help of the clone's stone body.
Hedao magical power is currently his trump card. If conditions permit, the fewer people who know about it, the better.
One month later, Ye Chenfeng and Yang Yuanhong confirmed that all the evil remnants in the Canglong clan had been cleared away, and immediately started preparing for the new mission.
Through this negotiation between the two parties, the Canglong clan also got the opportunity to rejoin Canglan with the permission of the Taoist Academy.
However, this opportunity is not open to all Canglong clan monks. It is conditional and staged.
After this incident, Yang Yuanhong and Shenwuhui continued to stay in the Canglong tribe for a period of time.
The former will enter the illusion of the Canglong clan lineage to gain spiritual enlightenment, and feed back the spirit clan lineage of this side with the breath of his true dragon and the aura of the Dragon Lord.
This is a win-win situation for both parties, and the four ancestors of the Canglong clan are naturally very happy.
But what they don't know is that Yang Yuanhong, in addition to seeking a breakthrough for his own dragon body cultivation needs in the Canglong clan's illusion, will also take this opportunity to enter the Canglong clan's lineage to find an opportunity for his son to enter the Tao.
Yang Xuancang is a variant of the innate blue dragon, and he has inherited Yang Yuanhong's physical talent very well, but as mentioned before, this child's qualifications are still far behind the top geniuses.
This gap in innate talent is difficult for Chen Yang to make up for through the gift of enlightenment. Therefore, in order to give their son a higher starting point for entering the Tao, Yang Yuanhong and Dongfang Yingcai have been trying their best to find various supplements for Yang Xuancang over the years.
